quote: **`ods-cli`** — main Bash CLI for managing the stack; keep changes narrow and follow `docs/ODS_CLI_DECOMPOSITION.md` for behavior-preserving split work
statement: In ods/ods-cli, changes should stay narrow and any split of the CLI must be behavior-preserving, following ods/docs/ODS_CLI_DECOMPOSITION.md.

quote: The installer is modular with a strict separation: `installers/lib/` contains pure functions (no side effects), `installers/phases/` contain sequential steps that execute on `source`.
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh, files must only define functions (no side effects at source time); executable install steps belong in ods/installers/phases/*.sh, which run when sourced.

quote: Every module has a standardized header (Purpose, Expects, Provides, Modder notes).
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh and ods/installers/phases/*.sh, every module must start with the standardized header containing Purpose, Expects, Provides and Modder notes fields.

quote: The orchestrator (`install-core.sh`) sets `INSTALL_PHASE` before each phase for error reporting.
statement: In ods/install-core.sh, the orchestrator must set INSTALL_PHASE before sourcing each phase.

quote: Every service is an extension under `extensions/services/<name>/`. Each has a `manifest.yaml` defining metadata (id, port, health endpoint, container name, aliases, category, GPU backends, feature flags).
statement: In ods/extensions/services/<name>/, every service directory must contain a manifest.yaml; core services (llama-server, open-webui, dashboard, dashboard-api) have only a manifest and their compose lives in docker-compose.base.yml.

quote: Services bind to `127.0.0.1` by default for security.
statement: In docker-compose*.yml and extension compose.yaml files, published service ports must bind to 127.0.0.1 by default.

quote: **Shell**: Bash with `set -euo pipefail`. Use `shellcheck` for linting.
statement: In all Bash scripts, code must run under `set -euo pipefail`.

quote: POSIX-compatible constructs preferred for macOS portability (avoid GNU-only date/grep).
statement: In shell scripts, code should use POSIX-compatible constructs and must not rely on GNU-only date/grep flags.

quote: **Python**: Standard formatting, consistent with existing file style. FastAPI for APIs. Pytest for tests.
statement: In Python services, HTTP APIs should be built with FastAPI and tests written with pytest.

quote: **JavaScript/React**: ESLint with flat config. Vite for bundling. Tailwind CSS for styling.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/dashboard/src, components should be styled with Tailwind CSS classes.

quote: **No broad or silent catches.** Never `except Exception: pass` or `except Exception: return None`.
statement: In Python code, code must not catch broad exceptions silently (no `except Exception: pass` or `except Exception: return None`).

quote: No retry/backoff loops. No fallback chains.
statement: In all code, code must not add retry/backoff loops or fallback chains.

quote: Health checks, network calls, and file I/O may catch *specific* exception types (e.g., `asyncio.TimeoutError`, `aiohttp.ClientConnectorError`) when each maps to a distinct, meaningful status.
statement: In Python code, exception handlers are allowed only at I/O boundaries (health checks, network calls, file I/O) and must catch specific exception types, each mapping to a distinct status.

quote: **Internal functions: let exceptions propagate.** The default is zero error handling — errors crash visibly with a full stack trace.
statement: In internal (non-boundary) functions, code must not catch exceptions; errors must propagate.

quote: Use `trap` handlers for context (see `install-core.sh`). If you must tolerate a failure, log it: `some_command || warn "failed (non-fatal)"`.
statement: In Bash scripts, a tolerated failure must be logged with `|| warn "..."` rather than silently ignored, and trap handlers should supply error context.

quote: Do not add new `|| true` or `2>/dev/null` without a comment explaining why the failure is safe to ignore
statement: In Bash scripts, new `|| true` or `2>/dev/null` must not be added without an accompanying comment explaining why the failure is safe to ignore.

quote: **Python boundaries: raise, don't swallow.** FastAPI routers validate input and `raise HTTPException`. Never return `None` to signal an error.
statement: In FastAPI routers (dashboard-api routers/), handlers must validate input and raise HTTPException on errors, and must never return None to signal an error.

quote: **Tests: let assertions fail visibly.** Never catch exceptions in tests to avoid failure.
statement: In test code, tests must not catch exceptions to avoid failure.

quote: One function, one job. Flatten deep nesting with early returns.
statement: In all code, functions should do one job and use early returns instead of deep nesting.

quote: No premature abstraction — wait for 3+ use cases.
statement: In all code, an abstraction should not be introduced until it has 3 or more use cases.

quote: Thresholds: functions > 30 lines, nesting > 3 levels, files > 500 lines → consider splitting.
statement: In all code, functions longer than 30 lines, nesting deeper than 3 levels, or files longer than 500 lines should be split.

quote: Default to pure for business logic, validation, data mapping (same inputs → same output, no side effects).
statement: In business logic, validation and data-mapping code, functions should be pure (no side effects).

quote: Push I/O to boundaries. Follow **functional core, imperative shell** — `installers/lib/` is the pure core, `installers/phases/` is the imperative shell.
statement: In the installer, I/O must live in ods/installers/phases/ (imperative shell) while ods/installers/lib/ stays the pure functional core.

quote: If purity adds excessive wiring, prefer a simple impure function with a comment.
statement: In all code, an intentionally impure function should carry a comment explaining why.

quote: **OCP**: Extend via config/data (extension manifests, backend JSON files), not code modification.
statement: In the stack, new services and backends should be added via config/data (extension manifests, config/backends/*.json) rather than by modifying code.

quote: **DIP**: Inject dependencies via env vars (Bash) and `Depends()` (FastAPI). Don't hardcode.
statement: In FastAPI code, dependencies must be injected via Depends(), and in Bash via environment variables, rather than hardcoded.

quote: New tests must run in CI: add them to a workflow step or to `ods/tests/ci-suite.txt`. ... A check fails when a test under `ods/tests` or `ods/extensions/services/*/tests` is not executed by CI and not recorded, with a reason, in `ods/tests/ci-not-run.txt`.
statement: In ods/tests and ods/extensions/services/*/tests, every test must be executed by a CI workflow (or listed in ods/tests/ci-suite.txt) or be recorded with a reason in ods/tests/ci-not-run.txt.

quote: The *Python Type Check* jobs fail on new mypy errors in dashboard-api, token-spy, privacy-shield and `ods/scripts`. Existing errors are recorded in `.github/mypy-baseline.json`
statement: In dashboard-api, token-spy, privacy-shield and ods/scripts/*.py, code must not introduce new mypy errors beyond .github/mypy-baseline.json.

quote: All services bind to `127.0.0.1` (localhost only). Canonical port assignments live in `config/ports.json`.
statement: In compose files, services must bind to 127.0.0.1 and their host port assignments must come from ods/config/ports.json.

quote: The manifest schema is enforced by `extensions/schema/service-manifest.v1.json`.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, manifests must validate against ods/extensions/schema/service-manifest.v1.json.

quote: **Error messages that actually help** — "what went wrong" and "what to do about it." No stack traces. No silent failures.
statement: In installer code, user-facing errors should say what went wrong and what to do, with no silent failures.

quote: BSD sed is not GNU sed. BSD date is not GNU date. If it runs on macOS, don't use GNU-only flags. Use `_sed_i` and `_now_ms`.
statement: In shell scripts that run on macOS, code must not use GNU-only sed/date flags and must use the `_sed_i` and `_now_ms` helpers instead of `sed -i` and millisecond `date`.

quote: **Bash compatibility** — macOS ships Bash 3.2. No associative arrays unless you guard for Bash 4+.
statement: In shell scripts, code must not use associative arrays (`declare -A`) unless guarded for Bash 4+.

quote: **Path handling** — Windows vs Unix, spaces, symlinks, external drives. Use `path-utils.sh`.
statement: In installer shell code, path handling should use the helpers in ods/installers/lib/path-utils.sh.

quote: **Tests for imaginary features.** A test suite that skip()'s every assertion because the feature doesn't exist yet is worse than no tests
statement: In test code, tests must target existing code and must not skip() their assertions for features that do not exist.

quote: **Code that was never run.** If your function is referenced but never defined, or your shell variable won't expand in exec form — we'll catch it.
statement: In code and Dockerfiles/compose commands, referenced functions must be defined and shell variables must not be used in exec-form commands where they will not expand.

quote: **Bash** — `set -euo pipefail` at the top. Quote your variables. Run `shellcheck`.
statement: In Bash scripts under ods/, `set -euo pipefail` must appear at the top of the file and variable expansions must be quoted.

quote: **Over-engineering.** If the fix is three lines, don't build a framework.
statement: In all code, fixes should not introduce framework-level abstractions for small changes.

quote: "no-unused-vars": ["warn", { argsIgnorePattern: "^_" }]
statement: In dashboard **/*.{js,jsx}, unused variables should not exist; unused function arguments must be prefixed with `_`.

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W  (family E)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff pycodestyle error rules (E family), except those ignored.

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W  (family F)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff Pyflakes rules (F family: unused imports/variables, undefined names).

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W  (family W)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff pycodestyle warning rules (W family).

quote: --ignore E501
statement: In ods/**/*.py, line length (E501) is not enforced.

quote: --ignore E701
statement: In ods/**/*.py, multiple statements on one line after a colon (E701) are not flagged.

quote: --ignore E731
statement: In ods/**/*.py, assigning a lambda expression to a name (E731) is allowed.

quote: --ignore E741
statement: In ods/**/*.py, ambiguous variable names such as l, O, I (E741) are allowed.

quote: --ignore E402
statement: In ods/**/*.py, module-level imports not at the top of the file (E402) are allowed.

quote: ruff check ods/ --target-version py39 --select E9
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must parse under Python 3.9 syntax (no 3.10+/3.12-only syntax such as backslashes inside f-string expressions).

quote: mypy $SOURCES --ignore-missing-imports --no-strict-optional --check-untyped-defs
statement: In dashboard-api, token-spy, privacy-shield and ods/scripts/*.py, bodies of unannotated functions must also type-check (mypy --check-untyped-defs).

quote: mypy ... --no-strict-optional
statement: In mypy-checked Python targets, strict Optional checking is turned off (None is not checked against non-Optional types).

quote: mypy ... --ignore-missing-imports
statement: In mypy-checked Python targets, imports of modules without type information are not reported.

quote: shellcheck --exclude=SC1091,SC2034 --severity=error (all ods/**/*.sh, plus ods/ods-cli and ods/bin/ods-pixel-approve)
statement: In ods/**/*.sh, ods/ods-cli and ods/bin/ods-pixel-approve, code must have no ShellCheck error-severity findings.

quote: --exclude=SC2034  exclude "unused variables" (many are used by sourced files)
statement: In shell scripts, unused variable warnings (SC2034) are not enforced.

quote: disable=SC1091 (also --exclude=SC1091 in lint-shell.yml)
statement: In shell scripts, ShellCheck's "not following sourced file" check (SC1091) is turned off.

quote: disable=SC1090
statement: In shell scripts, ShellCheck's non-constant source check (SC1090) is turned off.

quote: disable=SC3003
statement: In shell scripts, ANSI-C quoting $'...' is allowed (SC3003 turned off).

quote: Regression guard - no http://localhost in shell scripts ... grep -nE 'curl[^|]*http://localhost:' ... "use 127.0.0.1 (IPv6 ::1 resolution can hang on macOS)"
statement: In ods/**/*.sh and *.bash (except demo-offline.sh and test-extension-audit.sh), curl calls must not use http://localhost: and must use 127.0.0.1 instead.

quote: PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText = @{ Enable = $true }
statement: In PowerShell installer scripts, code must not use ConvertTo-SecureString with -AsPlainText.

quote: ExcludeRules = @( 'PSAvoidUsingWriteHost' ...
statement: In PowerShell scripts, use of Write-Host is allowed (PSAvoidUsingWriteHost excluded).

quote: 'PSAvoidUsingEmptyCatchBlock'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, empty catch blocks are not flagged (PSAvoidUsingEmptyCatchBlock excluded).

quote: 'PSUseBOMForUnicodeEncodedFile'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, a BOM for Unicode-encoded files is not required (PSUseBOMForUnicodeEncodedFile excluded).

quote: 'PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, state-changing functions are not required to support ShouldProcess (excluded).

quote: 'PSUseApprovedVerbs'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, function names are not required to use approved verbs (PSUseApprovedVerbs excluded).

quote: 'PSUseDeclaredVarsMoreThanAssignments'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, variables assigned but not used are not flagged (PSUseDeclaredVarsMoreThanAssignments excluded).

quote: 'PSUseSingularNouns'
statement: In PowerShell scripts, function nouns are not required to be singular (PSUseSingularNouns excluded).

quote: Every module uses a standardized header: #!/bin/bash / # ODS Installer — <Module Name> / # Part of: ... / # Purpose: ... / # Expects: ... / # Provides: ... / # Modder notes: ... If you add a new file, copy this template.
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh and ods/installers/phases/*.sh, each file must begin with the `#!/bin/bash` + `ODS Installer — <Module Name>` banner header listing Part of, Purpose, Expects, Provides and Modder notes.

quote: **Libraries are safe to source.** Every file in `lib/` defines functions only — no side effects. ... They must be sourced in order because later libraries depend on earlier ones
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh, files must define functions and constants only, with no top-level commands that execute on source.

quote: **Add a new phase** | `installers/phases/` | Create a numbered `.sh` file with the standard header, then add a `source` line in `install-core.sh` in the right order
statement: In ods/installers/phases/, new phases must be numbered NN-name.sh files with the standard header and be sourced from ods/install-core.sh in order.

quote: Plain mode never clears the screen, rings the terminal bell, or emits cursor-motion animation.
statement: In installer UI code (ods/installers/lib/ui.sh and platform equivalents), plain/non-TTY/NO_COLOR paths must not clear the screen, ring the bell, or emit cursor-motion escapes.

quote: Do not add absolute privacy, telemetry, subscription, rate-limit, or data-residency claims unless the selected configuration proves them.
statement: In installer lore and completion messages, code must not print absolute privacy/telemetry/data-residency claims unless the active runtime mode proves them.

quote: OpenCode must use `LITELLM_KEY` when it reaches the model through LiteLLM, which enforces auth, while direct llama-server paths keep `no-key`; the LiteLLM config for a Windows `llama-server.exe` must keep `extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: false`
statement: In generated-config writers, OpenCode config must use LITELLM_KEY for LiteLLM routes, and the Windows llama-server LiteLLM config must set enable_thinking: false and reference the key only as os.environ/LLAMA_SERVER_API_KEY.
scope: generated config writers (phases/06-directories.sh, phases/07-devtools.sh, installers/windows/lib/*.ps1, scripts/render-runtime-configs.py, scripts/bootstrap-upgrade.sh)

quote: A phase should mutate only the surfaces it owns.
statement: In ods/installers/phases/*.sh, each phase should mutate only the surfaces it owns per the phase contract table.

quote: Linux, macOS, Windows, host-agent, and bootstrap-upgrade writers must stay in sync for shared generated config.
statement: In generated-config writers, a change to shared generated config (.env, LiteLLM, Hermes, OpenCode, Perplexica, model routing) must be applied to every platform writer.
scope: installer phases, installers/macos, installers/windows, scripts/bootstrap-upgrade.sh, bin/ods-host-agent.py, dashboard-api routes

quote: UI presentation must not change phase exit codes, error propagation, interrupt behavior, structured progress records, or log evidence.
statement: In installer UI code, presentation logic must not alter phase exit codes, error propagation, interrupt handling, progress records or logs.

quote: No big-bang Rust, Go, Python, or Node rewrite.
statement: In ods/ods-cli, the CLI must stay shell-native Bash; command families are extracted into sourced Bash modules rather than rewritten in another language.

quote: `compose.yaml` present → **enabled** (included in stack) ... `compose.yaml.disabled` → **disabled** ... Core services (`category: core`) have no compose.yaml
statement: In extension directories, enabled state must be expressed by compose.yaml vs compose.yaml.disabled, and services with category core must not have a compose.yaml.

quote: Required root field: `schema_version: ods.services.v1` ... Service section: required: `id`, `name`, `port`, `health`
statement: In extension manifest.yaml files, the root must set schema_version: ods.services.v1 and the service section must define id, name, port and health.

quote: Feature section (optional list): required per feature: `id`, `name`, `description`, `icon`, `category`, `requirements`, `priority`
statement: In extension manifest.yaml files, each features entry must define id, name, description, icon, category, requirements and priority.

quote: LLM section (optional under `service`, required for LLM consumers) ... Apps that speak the OpenAI protocol should use the gateway alias by default and avoid persisting GGUF filenames, catalog ids, or other concrete model names.
statement: In manifests of services that consume an LLM, a service.llm block (consumes, route, pinning, probe) must be declared, and app configs should use the gateway alias rather than persisting concrete model names.

quote: `dashboard-api` (`routers/extensions.py:_scan_compose_content` ...) and `scripts/resolve-compose-stack.sh` (`_scan_user_compose_content` ...) run one rule set: the `# >>> shared compose policy >>>` block, kept byte-identical in both files
statement: In dashboard-api routers/extensions.py and ods/scripts/resolve-compose-stack.sh, the `# >>> shared compose policy >>>` block must be byte-identical.

quote: **Booleans:** `privileged` and `use_api_socket` must be absent or an explicit false
statement: In user and library extension compose files, `privileged` and `use_api_socket` must be absent or explicitly false.

quote: **Other files and containers:** no top-level `include`, `name`, `secrets`, `configs` or `models`; no service `extends`, `env_file`, `label_file`, `volumes_from`, `secrets`, `configs`, `post_start`/`pre_stop` hooks, ...
statement: In user and library extension compose files, top-level include/name/secrets/configs/models and service extends/env_file/label_file/volumes_from/secrets/configs/post_start/pre_stop keys must not be used.

quote: **Namespaces:** no `host` network/PID/IPC/UTS/user/cgroup namespace, and no `container:` or `service:` join outside the extension's own file.
statement: In user and library extension compose files, services must not use host network/PID/IPC/UTS/user/cgroup namespaces or join containers outside the extension's own file.

quote: `cap_add` only from Docker's default set (never `SYS_ADMIN`, `DAC_READ_SEARCH`, `NET_ADMIN`, ...); `security_opt` only `no-new-privileges`.
statement: In user and library extension compose files, cap_add must contain only Docker default capabilities and security_opt only no-new-privileges.

quote: **Users and groups:** no root user (`root`, `0`, `00`, `+0`); `group_add` only the GPU groups, only in a curated recipe's `compose.amd.yaml`.
statement: In user and library extension compose files, services must not run as root, and group_add may only add GPU groups in a curated recipe's compose.amd.yaml.

quote: **Volumes:** no absolute, `~`, Windows or `..` host paths, no Docker socket or named pipe. ... an imported (GitHub) recipe may bind only its own `./data/<id>` and `./config/<id>`.
statement: In user and library extension compose files, volumes must not bind absolute, ~, Windows or .. host paths, the Docker socket, or the whole ./data, ./config or .env.

quote: **Interpolation:** a guarded value may not use `${VAR}` / `$VAR` ... The exceptions are the shapes ODS core uses: the `${VIDEO_GID:-44}` / `${RENDER_GID:-992}` GPU groups, `${ODS_UID:-N}:${ODS_GID:-N}` users, `${VAR:-127.0.0.1}` port hosts and NVIDIA `device_ids`.
statement: In user and library extension compose files, guarded fields must not use ${VAR}/$VAR interpolation except the allowed core shapes (GPU group GIDs, ODS_UID/ODS_GID users, ${VAR:-127.0.0.1} port hosts, NVIDIA device_ids).

quote: Keep extension files ASCII and small; one service per directory is preferred.
statement: In extension directories, files should be ASCII and small, with one service per directory.

quote: **Scripts that load `.env`:** Source `lib/safe-env.sh` and use `load_env_file "<path>"`; do not use `eval` or `export $(grep ... .env | xargs)` (injection risk).
statement: In shell scripts that load .env, code must source lib/safe-env.sh and call load_env_file, and must not use eval or `export $(grep ... .env | xargs)`.

quote: Do not persist GGUF filenames, llama-server model names, or catalog ids in your app config. The gateway alias is the app contract.
statement: In extension service config for LLM consumers, base_url should be http://litellm:4000/v1 with model ods/current, and GGUF filenames, llama-server model names or catalog ids must not be persisted.

quote: Direct routes are allowed, but they are not the default. A direct route must declare `pinning: dynamic` and a probe that proves the app refreshed to the new model after a swap.
statement: In manifest.yaml, a service.llm block with route: direct must declare pinning: dynamic and a probe.

quote: A service referenced by `depends_on` must exist in every resolved file set that includes that dependency.
statement: In compose files, every service named in depends_on must be defined in every resolved file set that includes the dependent.

quote: Hardware overlays should change runtime flags, devices, images, or build targets only for the relevant backend.
statement: In hardware overlay compose files (docker-compose.{nvidia,amd,apple,...}.yml, compose.<gpu>.yaml), changes should be limited to runtime flags, devices, images or build targets for that backend.

quote: If the service needs GPU-specific runtime flags, add backend overlays in the service directory instead of modifying unrelated global overlays.
statement: In extensions needing GPU flags, the flags must go in compose.<backend>.yaml inside the service directory, not in global docker-compose.<backend>.yml overlays.

quote: avoid host port bindings when the placeholder never runs
statement: In compose placeholder services, host port bindings should not be declared when the placeholder never runs.

quote: Internal service-to-service traffic should use container DNS and internal ports. Host-facing port defaults belong in `config/ports.json` and service manifests.
statement: In service config, internal service-to-service URLs should use container DNS names and internal ports, and host-facing port defaults must be defined in ods/config/ports.json and manifests.

quote: The manifest `service.id`, compose service key, `container_name`, and data directory should all use the same service identity.
statement: In an extension, manifest service.id, the compose service key, container_name and the data directory name should be the same identifier.

quote: keep persistent data under `./data/<service-id>/` ... declare secrets in `service.env_vars` ... use healthchecks that work before login ... avoid broad host filesystem mounts
statement: In extension compose and manifest files, persistent data should live under ./data/<service-id>/, secrets should be declared in service.env_vars, healthchecks should work before login, and broad host mounts should be avoided.

quote: `schema/service-manifest.v1.json` is a generated standalone mirror ... Update it from the repository root with `python3 scripts/sync-manifest-schema.py`; do not edit the mirror directly.
statement: In ods/extensions/library/schema/service-manifest.v1.json, the file must not be hand-edited; it is regenerated with scripts/sync-manifest-schema.py.

quote: Always use `set -e` to fail on errors ... Check if changes are needed before making them ... DON'T: Delete user data ... Assume files exist (check first)
statement: In migration scripts, code must use `set -e`, check whether changes are needed before applying them, check that files exist, and must not delete user data.

quote: `.github/scripts/test_security_workflows.py` fails if a workflow references `claude-code-action` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
statement: In .github/workflows/*.yml, workflows must not reference claude-code-action or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

quote: New source access belongs behind a projection broker, writes belong behind a separate actuator, and machine work belongs behind a named Operations action or an exact break-glass proposal.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, new source access must go through a projection broker, writes through a separate actuator, and machine work through a named Operations action.

quote: Do not add a generic Frontier prompt, file, repository, URL, message, or log forwarder.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, code must not add a generic Frontier prompt/file/repository/URL/message/log forwarder.

quote: A bug fix must add a regression that fails before the fix.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, every bug fix must add a regression test that fails before the fix.

quote: Generated repository file | release constants/env/tables, docs status/CLI/schema/config references | Never hand-edit; change generator or source, then regenerate
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, generated files (release constants, generated docs) must not be hand-edited; release pins are edited only in RELEASE-MANIFEST.json and compatibility state only in OPENCLAW-COMPATIBILITY.json, then regenerated.
